description: An unknown ATV trail fork was encountered mid-EVA. The team could not determine where either branch led, and was concerned about creating new tracks in pristine terrain.
response: Both forks were abandoned; the crew returned on the known route.
lesson: Pre-load all known ATV trail GPS coordinates from previous crew reports before departure. Protocol: if a trail is unknown and unmarked, do not explore it during simulation — log coordinates and report.
source_citation: SRC-hypatia-iii-brief, Part IV – Incident and emergency register, §4.3 Operational incidents, lines 656-661. Register Crew tag: 'C16'. Sol: not stated; 'mid-EVA' placed at a representative mid-mission point. Confidence (B) rationale: EVA-narrative entry; classified Near-Miss since the crew turned back before creating new tracks or getting lost, avoiding rather than incurring the harm.
